Specification: This module defines helper operators for deriving ShiViz-compatible metadata from a TLC execution trace, specifically identifying which process changed program counter values between consecutive states and computing a vector clock over the trace. It uses the special Toolbox trace variables `_TETrace` and `_TEPosition`, together with JSON conversion utilities, to expose a current host and clock value for visualization. The module is not a transition-system specification with variables, actions, or temporal properties; instead, it is a trace-analysis utility module built from operator definitions and comments about Toolbox override behavior.

IF _TETrace[i-1].pc = _TETrace[i].pc THEN host[i-1] ELSE CHOOSE p \in DOMAIN _TETrace[i-1].pc : _TETrace[i-1].pc[p] # _TETrace[i].pc[p]
IF n = 1 THEN [p \in DOMAIN _TETrace[n].pc |-> 0] ELSE [p \in DOMAIN _TETrace[n].pc |-> IF p = FnHost[n] THEN 1 ELSE 0]
IF i = 1 THEN clock(i) ELSE sum(TLCEval(vclock[i-1]), clock(i))
